task_1.title: Harden Windows package storage replacement against antivirus locks
task_1.description: The update improves reliability when Conan replaces package storage files on Windows by retrying transient replacement failures commonly caused by antivirus file locking, while also making replacement failures surface as explicit errors instead of warning-only outcomes.

synthesized_requirement.problem_statement: Ensure that package storage updates tolerate transient file-replacement failures on Windows, especially when antivirus software temporarily blocks access, and fail clearly if the replacement still cannot be completed.

expectation.grounded: When Conan performs the package-storage replacement step on Windows using os.replace(), an OSError during that operation should trigger a small bounded retry sequence with warnings between attempts. If a retry succeeds, the replacement should complete normally. If all retries fail, Conan should raise ConanException for the failed replacement. On non-Windows platforms, a replacement failure should not be treated as warning-only; it should fail immediately with ConanException.
expectation.conceptual: Windows cache and package writes should automatically recover from short-lived file locks during replacement, but persistent replacement failures must still stop the operation with a clear error. Platforms not affected by this transient-lock handling should continue to fail fast on replacement errors.

constraints.grounded: Keep the replacement based on the atomic file-replace operation, limit retries to a finite number, emit observable warnings only for intermediate Windows failures, and do not silently suppress the final failure. Do not extend the retry behavior to non-Windows platforms.
constraints.conceptual: The fix must improve resilience to temporary Windows-only interference without masking permanent storage errors, waiting indefinitely, or changing behavior on other operating systems beyond reporting true replacement failures as errors.

behavior: On Windows, a package-storage replacement failure from os.replace() is retried a limited number of times instead of failing immediately.
Each intermediate failed Windows attempt emits a warning indicating the replacement failed and that antivirus interference with the Conan cache may be involved.
If a later Windows retry succeeds, the replacement completes without raising an exception.
If all Windows replacement attempts fail, Conan raises ConanException for the storage update failure.
On non-Windows platforms, a package-storage replacement failure raises ConanException immediately instead of being left as a warning-only condition.
acceptance_criteria: When a Windows package-storage replacement is blocked transiently and succeeds on a later attempt, the operation should complete successfully without a final exception.
When a Windows package-storage replacement fails on an initial attempt but more retries remain, Conan should emit a warning and retry automatically.
When every Windows replacement attempt fails, the operation should terminate with ConanException.
When a replacement failure occurs on a non-Windows platform, the operation should fail immediately with ConanException.
When the replacement ultimately fails, the failure should be observable as an error condition rather than only a logged warning.
